description: This file defines the Filter controller class for the OpenCart admin interface, managing filter groups including listing, creating, editing, deleting, and autocompleting filters within the catalog module.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing filter groups in the catalog section of OpenCart admin panel, including operations like listing, editing, deleting, and autocompleting filter entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the main filter management page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading required sub-views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls the getList method to output a list of filter groups.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares a paginated list of filter groups, including sorting, filtering, and links for editing filter groups.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a filter group, loading data if editing an existing group.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding or updating) filter group data via POST request, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected filter groups after permission and product association checks.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete list of filters based on partial name input for the UI.
